blocks.x: There’s nothing like climbing into a cozy, cloud-like bed at a luxury hotel after a long travel day. From the uber-soft pillows and crisp, cool sheets to the big fluffy robe and cozy slippers, the best hotels in the world know a thing or two about keeping their guests comfortable. But thanks to the comfort experts at Brooklinen, it’s entirely possible to recreate five-star sleep at home. I’ve been recommending Brooklinen to friends and family for years—the brand’s sheets really are the comfiest I’ve ever slept on. Everything from its best-selling linens to duvet covers, pillows, robes, towels, and blankets are designed for high-end shut-eye. If you’re ready to upgrade your bedding, make the switch to Brooklinen—and thank me later. Below, I’ve rounded up the best Brooklinen discount codes available now, so you can save on the best sleep you’ve ever had.
Get 15% off your first order with this Brooklinen discount code

New to Brooklinen? You're in luck: The beloved bedding brand is offering 15% off your first order. To take advantage of this first-time offer from Brooklinen, be sure to add the discount code 15-627820 at check out. This Brooklinen discount code can be used sitewide, from cozy sheets and comforters to soft robes and towels. Whether you're shopping for a new home or just need to upgrade some bed and bathroom essentials for the new season, Brooklinen has you covered.
Sign up for emails to get a $10 off Brooklinen discount

Looking for an easy way to save? Sign up for Brooklinen’s email list and receive an exclusive $10 discount. These emails will keep you posted on the latest promotions, discounts, and sales from Brooklinen. Your $10 off discount can be used sitewide, including purchases of the brand's best-selling Classic Percale Core sheet set (my favorite), the Luxe Sateen Core sheet set, the Washed European Linen Core sheet set, and more.
Find Brooklinen final sale items at discounts of up to 78%

Right now, you can find discounts of up to 78% off bedding, blankets, and robes in Brooklinen’s Last Call sale section. Save on select cotton sheet sets, duvet covers, and waffle throw blankets. Travel essentials are also part of the Last Call sale, including the Marlow Mini Pillow (currently 50% off). But hurry: These last-chance sales won’t stick around long, so don’t wait to snag something you’ve got your eye on.
Save 30% on Brooklinen bundles without a coupon code this fall

Score up to 30% off when you buy a bundle from Brooklinen, offering you another great chance to save. Save 30% off the Classic Percale sheet bundle, 25% off the Luxe Sateen duvet bundle, 25% off the Washed Percale comforter bundle, and more. Customers can find premium bedding and bath bundles marked down right now, allowing you to get more while spending less.
Get free shipping and returns on orders over $100

I’ve been burned many times by hefty, unexpected shipping fees on online orders. Luckily, Brooklinen offers free shipping on all orders of $100 or more. And since the brand’s sheet sets and bundles hit that threshold, you’re almost guaranteed free shipping. One of my favorite things about the brand, besides its crisp Percale sheets, is its generous return window, typically allowing customers to return or exchange items for up to 365 days. That way, you have plenty of time to fall in love with your bedding—and if you don’t, there’s no need to worry.
How to fix a Brooklinen promo code that’s not working

If your Brooklinen promo code isn't working at checkout, don't panic—there are a few things you can do. Start by double checking that your code is spelled correctly and that there are no typos. Shoppers should also check the details of the promo code to ensure it's still active and hasn't expired. Some discount codes are limited to first-time shoppers, or require you spend a certain amount with your purchase. If everything looks good and your Brooklinen promo code still isn't working, clear your browser's cache and give the page a refresh. When in doubt, contact Brooklinen's customer service for help.
